summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow iteration 11 features: Avatar upload, server-side pagination, search, email config, and WhatsApp/Email share deeplinks. All 37 backend tests pass. All frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/users/avatar - uploads PNG/JPEG images successfully, returns {avatar: '/api/users/avatar/{user_id}'}
Backend: GET /api/users/avatar/{user_id} - returns uploaded image with correct content-type
Backend: Avatar upload rejects files >5MB with 400 error
Backend: Avatar upload rejects non-image files (txt, pdf) with 400 error
Backend: Avatar upload requires authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
Backend: GET /api/meetings pagination returns {meetings, total, page, limit, pages}
Backend: GET /api/meetings?search=xxx filters by title correctly
Backend: GET /api/meetings?meeting_type=upcoming/past filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/recordings pagination returns {recordings, total, page, pages}
Backend: GET /api/transcripts pagination returns {transcripts, total, page, pages}
Backend: GET /api/admin/email-config returns config with masked API key
Backend: PUT /api/admin/email-config saves provider/api_key/sender_email/enabled
Backend: POST /api/admin/email-config/test returns status (simulated)
Backend: Email config endpoints require admin role
Frontend Dashboard: Pagination controls visible (44 meetings, 5 pages)
Frontend Dashboard: Prev/Next buttons work, prev disabled on page 1
Frontend Dashboard: Search debounced, filters meetings server-side
Frontend Dashboard: Tab switching (Upcoming/Past) fetches from server
Frontend Dashboard: WhatsApp share option in dropdown menu ('Per WhatsApp teilen')
Frontend Dashboard: Email share option in dropdown menu ('Per E-Mail teilen')
Frontend Profile: Avatar image displayed (red circle from test upload)
Frontend Profile: Avatar upload button present with hover camera icon
Frontend Profile: 'Foto ändern' link present and triggers file upload
Frontend Profile: Name input editable and saves correctly
Frontend Profile: Language select present
Frontend Profile: Save button works, shows 'Profil aktualisiert' toast
Frontend Admin: E-Mail tab with provider select, enabled toggle, save button
Frontend Recordings: Search input present
Frontend Recordings: Tabs show counts (Recordings: 9, Transcripts: 4)
Frontend Calendar: Loads meetings correctly (62 events displayed)
seed_data_creation: Avatar uploaded during testing (1x1 red PNG)
